request_preview.prompt: Vertical 9:16 aesthetic product film. Extreme macro of a vintage floral phone-case pattern, shallow depth of field, warm natural window light. Slowly rotate the phone to show the printed floral artwork, soft-shell edge and camera opening. Transition to a styled desk scene with paper, lace texture and dried flowers, keeping the phone as the clear hero. Calm premium-looking cinematography without claiming premium materials. No people, no logos, no embedded text.

Vertical 9:16 product commercial. Start with a plain smartphone on a clean neutral desk in soft daylight. A hand passes briefly across the lens as a transition. Reveal the same phone wearing a soft-shell vintage floral case with delicate botanical artwork. Smooth macro camera move over the printed flowers, TPU edge and camera cutout. Finish with a tasteful flatlay beside a notebook and dried flowers. Natural motion, realistic materials, clean ecommerce lighting, no logos, no extra text rendered into the scene. Leave negative space for later captions.

Vertical 9:16 before-and-after product ad. Begin with a generic plain phone case on a minimal desk. Use a fast swipe transition to reveal the same phone in a vintage floral soft-shell case. Show three quick detail shots: floral print, flexible-looking TPU edge, camera cutout. End on a clean product hero shot with neutral background and empty lower-third space for a later compatibility and shipping disclaimer. Realistic ecommerce style, no logos, no claims rendered into video.
